name: Seated Chin Nod & Glide
easierVariant: Do a tiny 1-cm nod while resting the back of your head against a headrest or wall.
harderVariant: Hold each gentle glide for 5 slow seconds while lengthening the crown of your head.
cues: Sit tall with eyes level on the horizon.
Gently glide your chin straight back (like making a soft double chin).
Keep your jaw and front neck muscles completely relaxed.
dontCue: Do not tilt your head backward or jam your chin down into your chest.
breathingCue: Inhale tall, exhale as you glide back for 3 seconds.

name: Slow Shoulder Blade Rolls
easierVariant: Keep hands resting on your thighs and make smaller, whisper-soft circles.
harderVariant: Fingertips on shoulders, drawing slow circles with your elbows.
cues: Float your shoulders gently up toward your ears.
Roll them back and melt your shoulder blades down into your back pockets.
Keep your neck long and gaze soft.
dontCue: Avoid shrugging hard or forcing painful clicks.
breathingCue: Inhale as shoulders rise, exhale slowly as they melt down.

name: Scapular Posture Reset
easierVariant: Squeeze at only 30% effort with arms relaxed by your sides.
harderVariant: Bend elbows to 90 degrees and rotate thumbs slightly outward as you squeeze.
cues: Let your arms hang naturally or bend elbows to 90 degrees.
Draw your shoulder blades gently together and slightly downward.
Hold for 3 calm seconds, then release completely.
dontCue: Do not arch your lower back or puff your ribs forward.
breathingCue: Exhale during the gentle squeeze, inhale to release.

name: Open-Book Chest Opener
easierVariant: Place hands on your lower ribs or hips and gently widen your collarbones.
harderVariant: Interlace fingers behind your chair or back and lift chest softly.
cues: Sit near the front edge of your chair with feet flat.
Open your arms wide with palms facing forward.
Feel a warm, gentle stretch across the front of your chest.
dontCue: Stop before any pinching in the back of your shoulders.
breathingCue: Take 4 deep breaths into your upper chest.

name: Seated Spinal Wave
easierVariant: Keep the movement micro-sized — just tilting your pelvis 1 inch forward and back.
harderVariant: Slide hands along thighs as you flow smoothly through mid and upper back.
cues: Rest your hands comfortably on your knees.
Inhale to rock onto your sit bones and lift your breastbone slightly.
Exhale to round your mid-back gently and soften your shoulders.
dontCue: Do not force end-range lumbar arching or deep flexion if your lower back is sensitive.
breathingCue: Match each slow wave to a full inhale and exhale.

name: Wrist Circles & Tendon Glides
easierVariant: Rest forearms on armrests and gently open and close your fingers.
harderVariant: Extend arms forward and add gentle palm-up / palm-down forearm turns.
cues: Start with fingers straight, then curl fingertips into a hook, then a soft fist.
Open palms wide and circle wrists slowly 5 times each way.
Shake out hands as if flicking water droplets off your fingers.
dontCue: Never press hard into bent wrists.
breathingCue: Breathe naturally and relax your jaw.

name: Seated Hip & Glute Release
easierVariant: Cross one ankle over the opposite shin instead of the knee, and sit tall.
harderVariant: Hinge 2 inches forward from your hips while keeping your spine long.
cues: Sit tall and cross one ankle over your opposite thigh (or shin if knees are sensitive).
Keep your spine long and hinge slightly from the hip crease.
Switch sides halfway through.
dontCue: Do not push down on your knee joint or round your lower back.
breathingCue: Exhale to soften hip tension on each breath.

name: Standing Hip Extension & Reach
easierVariant: Simply stand up, rest hands on your hips, and take 3 tall breaths.
harderVariant: Step one foot slightly back into a split stance and reach one arm overhead.
cues: Stand up with feet hip-width apart and knees soft.
Rest your palms on the top of your glutes and lengthen your torso upward.
Feel the front of your hips open after sitting.
dontCue: Do not lean backward from your lower back; think 'up and tall' instead.
breathingCue: Inhale to lengthen upward, exhale to ground your heels.

name: Controlled Chair Sit-to-Stands
easierVariant: Use your hands on the chair armrests to assist, or place a cushion on the seat to make it higher.
harderVariant: Pause 1 second just above the seat before standing back up.
cues: Place feet hip-width apart with heels grounded.
Lean slightly forward from the hips and press through your whole foot to stand tall.
Lower back down to the chair with smooth control.
dontCue: Do not let your knees cave inward; stop if you feel any knee pinch.
breathingCue: Exhale as you stand up, inhale as you sit back.

name: Ankle Pumps & Alphabet Circles
easierVariant: Keep heels on the floor and gently lift toes up and down.
harderVariant: Stand holding your desk and perform slow heel raises.
cues: Extend one leg slightly under your desk.
Point your toes gently away, then pull them back toward your shin.
Draw slow circles with your big toe, then switch feet.
dontCue: Move smoothly without cramping your foot arch.

name: 20-20-20 Gaze & Palming Reset
easierVariant: Simply close your eyes and rest your hands in your lap for 30 seconds.
harderVariant: Trace a slow figure-8 with your eyes before palming.
cues: Look away from your screen at a distant object at least 20 feet away.
Blink slowly 5 times to refresh your tear film.
Rub palms together until warm and cup them lightly over closed eyes.
dontCue: Do not press on your eyeballs.

name: Calm Belly & Rib Breathing
easierVariant: Breathe at your own natural rhythm with one hand resting on your belly.
harderVariant: Inhale for 4 counts, pause 2 counts, exhale softly for 6 counts.
cues: Rest one hand on your lower ribs and let your shoulders drop.
Inhale gently through your nose for 4 seconds, feeling your ribs widen.
Exhale slowly for 6 seconds, letting jaw and shoulder tension melt.
dontCue: Never strain or hold your breath if you feel lightheaded.

name: Standing Wall or Backrest Slides
easierVariant: Keep elbows low by your ribs and only slide 2 inches up and down.
harderVariant: Stand with back against a wall, ribs down, and slide arms in a smooth 'W' to 'Y'.
cues: Stand tall (or sit tall) with elbows bent in a comfortable 'W' shape.
Reach arms gently upward only as far as your shoulders stay relaxed.
Draw elbows back down toward your back pockets.
dontCue: Stop below shoulder height if you have shoulder impingement or pinching.
breathingCue: Inhale to reach, exhale to draw elbows down.

name: Gentle Seated Quad & Knee Glide
easierVariant: Slide your heel forward along the floor without lifting the foot high.
harderVariant: Hold the leg straight for 3 seconds with thigh muscles gently engaged.
cues: Sit tall with thighs supported by your chair.
Slowly straighten one knee until your leg is comfortably extended.
Hold 2 seconds, lower smoothly, and alternate legs.
dontCue: Do not lock or hyperextend the knee joint forcefully.
breathingCue: Exhale as you extend, inhale as you lower.

name: Easy Desk March & Arm Swing
easierVariant: Perform a seated heel-lift march right in your chair.
harderVariant: Lift knees slightly higher and swing arms loosely for 60 seconds.
cues: Stand beside your desk and march lightly on the balls of your feet.
Let your arms swing naturally to loosen stiff shoulders.
Keep your posture tall and steps quiet.
dontCue: No jumping or heavy pounding on joints.
